    Professional Summary
    
      Biostatistician with 5+ years of experience in pharmaceutical clinical development, 
      clinical assay statistics, and translational research. Skilled in designing and executing 
      rigorous statistical analyses spanning longitudinal and repeated-measures models, 
      time-to-event methods, high-dimensional data, and Bayesian methods. Strong SAS and R 
      programmer with advanced R Shiny development experience; familiar with CDISC standards 
      and reproducible, audit-ready workflows.
    
  

  
  
    Core Competencies
    
      Statistical Modelling
      Survival Analysis
      Biomarker Statistics
      Mixed Models
      High-Dimensional Data
      Bayesian Methods
      R & R Shiny

      CDISC SDTM/ADaM

      Regulatory Writing
    
  

  
  
    Professional Experience

    
      
        Statistician – Vx Clinical Assay Statistics (Consultant)
        Jul 2023 – Sep 2025
      
      GSK via Enovalife · Brussels, Belgium
      
        Led statistical design, analysis, and interpretation of clinical assay experiments supporting vaccine immunogenicity programmes.
        Provided statistical expertise across assay development, validation, and lifecycle management, including performance characterisation relevant to pharmacodynamic and predictive endpoints.
        Developed and executed statistical analysis plans.
        Championed R adoption across teams; designed and deployed R Shiny dashboards and analysis tools to enhance reproducibility, traceability, and reporting.
        Communicated statistical results and deliverables to cross-functional teams including clinical scientists, laboratory leads, and senior decision-makers.
      
    

    
      
        Statistician – Vx Preclinical & Research Statistics (Consultant)
        May 2022 – Jul 2023
      
      GSK via Enovalife · Brussels, Belgium
      
        Performed analysis of preclinical data to support preclinical and translational research questions.
        Designed and implemented statistical analysis plans.
        Participated in cross-functional planning meetings on statistical methodology and experimental design.
        Conducted QC and compiled analysis reports.
      
    

    
      
        Statistician – Health Data Scientist
        Jan 2020 – Mar 2021
      
      INSERM · Bordeaux, France
      
        Wrote and maintained statistical analysis plans for high-dimensional survival data studies, including analyses incorporating biomarker endpoints.
        Implemented advanced statistical methods including time-to-event models, penalised regression, and machine learning approaches.
        Built and evaluated prediction models with candidate biomarker covariates.
        Co-authored research communications.
      
    

    
      
        Epidemiologist
        Sep 2015 – Aug 2016
      
      Cameroon Society of Epidemiology (CaSE) · Yaoundé, Cameroon
      
        Designed and validated data collection tools.
        Supervised vaccine programme epidemiological investigations and public health surveillance.
        Involved in primary health care activities: infant immunization, community health surveys.
      
    

    
      
        Microbiologist
        Nov 2013 – Jan 2015
      
      Central Hospital (HCY) · Yaoundé, Cameroon
      
        Collected and analysed laboratory samples; performed isolation of bacteria and microorganisms.
        Prepared culture media and implemented lab experiments for diagnosis and treatment.

    About
    
      I am a biostatistician with experience spanning vaccine immunogenicity, 
      (pre)clinical research, and high-dimensional survival analyses. My work at 
      GSK (via Enovalife) and INSERM has focused on designing and executing 
      rigorous statistical analyses that directly inform clinical and regulatory 
      decision-making.
    
    
      I hold Master's degrees in Public Health Data Science (University of Bordeaux), Applied            Statistics (University of Hasselt), 
      and Epidemiology (University of Buea). I am also a holder of the Advanced 
      Certificate in Practical Applications of Bayesian Statistics in Clinical Trials 
      (London School of Business & Research).
    
    
      Outside of consulting, I enjoy building R Shiny tools that make statistical 
      outputs more accessible to cross-functional teams. I am a biayesian enthusiast as well!
